alex_zhang: FYI nightly eval spike on en_qa prompt set — quality down ~6.3 pts vs baseline. suspect cache key shadowing between quantized and float variants when narrow batching is on. attaching short repro logs.

maria_g: saw the alert on the dashboard, nice catch. which model/commit?

alex_zhang: model=rwd-2b-instruct-v3, commit=7a9f2e, serving in dedicated pool 'pool-narrow-3' with narrow batching enabled. failures typically show token substitutions 4-8 tokens into generation.

chen: can you paste one of the bad gens?

alex_zhang: here is one from nightly run 2024-04-13 03:10 UTC:
```
INPUT: Q: What is the capital of France?
EXPECTED: Paris
GENERATION: Paris
BAD_CASE: Paria
NOTES: single-letter substitution near token boundary, model confident (p=0.92)
```

eva_ml: I ran a quick local with quantized variant + narrow batch size=4 — reproduced ~1/20 runs. looks nondeterministic but correlated with prefix lengths >32 tokens.

sre-bot: deploy pool-narrow-3 @ 1718234600 completed (rev 7a9f2e) :white_check_mark:

samir_ops: any low-risk mitigations we can flip now?

alex_zhang: temporary mitigation = disable narrow batching for that model and enable strict per-tenant cache namespaces. after disabling narrow batching in a canary preview, nightly preview error drops to baseline.

maria_g: good. can we add a synthetic unit that forces collisions to avoid regressions?

chen: I'll add a test that fuzzes prefix keys and KV slots, forcing high collision probability. plan: generate 10k synthetic prefixes with small hamming distances and run 100 seeded inferences with mixed quant/float variants.

alex_zhang: filing ticket INF-4321 with repro, logs, and a list of failing prompts (attached). tagging @eng-runtime for kernel/hash review.

chen: early hypothesis: we truncate hash to 64-bit then map to 16-bit slot index (low bits). when prefix vectors have similar suffixes the low bits collide more than expected. combined with narrow batching reusing slot allocations, KV values can be mixed across requests.

eva_ml: that matches the intermittent nature. quantized state seems more sensitive to stale KV because tiny probability shifts cascade into wrong tokens.

samir_ops: i'll schedule a canary window for the mitigation (disable narrow batching) tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC and run stress for 6h.

alex_zhang: thanks — will push the failing prompt set to INF-4321 and add the nightly eval comparison charts. :thumbsup:

maria_g: once chen has the unit test, let's gate it in nightly CI so we don't regress. small follow-ups: (1) add histogram of slot collisions per minute; (2) consider using full 64-bit modulus for slots or double-hash.

chen: ack. I'll prototype double-hash mapping and run local perf to check overhead.

alex_zhang: keeping this thread for updates. if anyone reproduces a different pattern post-mitigation ping here.

sre-bot: NOTE: alert resolved in nightly eval after mitigation flag applied (1718238200)

eva_ml: added 5 failing samples to INF-4321 and ran quick eval — looks stable so far.

samir_ops: can we add a dashboard panel for "slot-collision-rate" per pool? will help long-term monitoring.

alex_zhang: agreed, putting it on the eng-ml sprint for next week. :rocket:
